_doc: HF106: JVM-FLAG PROBES. A mod registration reachable only under a JVM system-property read (a developer launch flag: a test harness, an automated-test run) is never registered on a player's game, client and integrated server alike, so the server cannot hold the channel and a claim of it fails the negotiation (missing.client.server). Each row is one probe the evaluator tags: owner + method + descriptor (the JDK call as the bytes name it) and the value shape its result takes. shapes: property_string = the read returns the property's String (a branch on it is read through String.equals against a constant); property_boolean = the read returns the flag's boolean. Every row cites the real jar it was read from (file name, sha1, the class and the javap lines of the F41 forensics). Add a row only with such a citation.
